title: Anne N NDE 6288/6305
content:
6305 I was in a drug-induced coma; on a respirator and life support, after a pulmonary hemorrhage caused by severe lupus. I also had organ (kidney) failure and traumatic brain injury due to oxygen deprivation. I was not expected to live, but I came back completely healed from my lupus after my NDE. I have been totally well since, with no trace of Lupus since 2005. I was sent back well! I may have been clinically dead, as I had no brain function according to a scan. I was not expected to live and when I was disconnected from the respirator, I was suddenly in a dimly-lit room by myself. I noticed, in particular, that this room had a door, which I felt was special in some way. Then I became aware that I was no longer alone. God was there! I felt God as an all-encompassing presence, complete total and unconditional love in its highest form! Even though I saw no figure, there was no doubt in my mind that this was God. Then He spoke, and it was with such compassion: He said, 'Are you too tired?' I knew He was asking me if I was too tired to go through that door. Through that door would be my death. I do not recall my answer, whether God sent me back, or if I made the decision, but I do know I was given a choice. So it must have been my choice to come back. Miraculously, God sent me back WELL!! After many years of severe suffering with the pain and illness of lupus, when I came back, my lupus was completely gone! Since my NDE, all tests for lupus come up clear! This has been true every single day since my NDE.

diagnosis.diagnosis_raw: Severe lupus with pulmonary hemorrhage; organ (kidney) failure; traumatic brain injury due to oxygen deprivation.
diagnosis.severity_description: severe; life-threatening (pulmonary hemorrhage, kidney failure, oxygen deprivation/brain injury); not expected to live
diagnosis.quality_of_life_impact: many years of severe suffering with pain and illness; drug-induced coma; respirator and life support

treatment.treatments_raw: Drug-induced coma; on a respirator and life support; disconnected from the respirator.

remission_outcome.time_to_remission_raw: when I came back (after my NDE)
remission_outcome.verification_detail: Patient reports that since the NDE, all tests for lupus have come up clear, with no trace of lupus since 2005.
remission_outcome.follow_up_duration_raw: every single day since my NDE; no trace of Lupus since 2005

positive_emotion_practices: NDE experience of 'complete total and unconditional love' (God's presence)
turner_factors.spiritual_practices_raw: Direct encounter with God during NDE; communication with God.
turner_factors.purpose_details: Implied by being given a choice to return and choosing to come back.

existential_shift.identity_shift_description: Encounter with God described as all-encompassing unconditional love; returned 'sent back well'.
existential_shift.surrender_description: Reported being given a choice about going through a door (death) and returning; attributes return to God.
existential_shift.transformation_narrative: God asked, 'Are you too tired?' implying a choice about death; patient returned and reports complete healing.
existential_shift.pivot_point_description: Moment in dimly lit room with a door representing death; God present; asked if too tired; choice to return.
existential_shift.transformation_timing: During NDE, immediately prior to returning to body and reporting lupus gone.

anomalous_experience.experience_description: During coma/life support, experienced being in a dimly lit room with a door representing death; sensed God's all-encompassing presence and heard God ask, 'Are you too tired?' and was given a choice to return; returned 'sent back well'.
anomalous_experience.experience_timing: While disconnected from respirator / during coma and near death from pulmonary hemorrhage and organ failure.

correspondential_markers.resolution_type: NDE encounter with God; choice about death/return; experience of unconditional love preceding reported complete lupus remission.

validation.statistical_improbability_notes: Narrative describes severe lupus with pulmonary hemorrhage, kidney failure, and reported absent brain function on scan; patient reports complete and lasting remission since 2005.
validation.extraction_notes: No specific antibody names/values, imaging reports, or physician statements provided; remission verification based on self-reported 'all tests for lupus come up clear' and long-term wellness since 2005.

analysis.case_summary: Patient with severe lupus complicated by pulmonary hemorrhage, kidney failure, and oxygen-deprivation brain injury was in a drug-induced coma on life support and reports an NDE involving an encounter with God and a choice to return. After returning, she reports complete remission of lupus with consistently clear lupus tests and no trace of disease since 2005.
key_healing_factors: Near-death experience with perceived encounter with God
Perceived choice to return to life
Attribution of healing to divine intervention
Sustained remission reported with ongoing clear lupus tests since 2005
unique_features: Reported 'no brain function according to a scan' during critical illness
Immediate reported disappearance of lupus upon return from NDE
analysis.analysis_notes: Narrative is duplicated in the source text; structured extraction reflects the repeated content once.
